listing.name: Hard Corps: Uprising (Hard Corps: Uprising Recompiled)
listing.summary: Prepared Hard Corps: Uprising copy, from the Windows package or Linux AppImage, using your own matching XBLA package. Keep upstream setup, optional DLC, runtime replacement and player data outside Portcove management.

steps.title: Keep the complete package together
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream guide. Keep the complete package, runtime libraries, configuration and notices in a writable folder. Do not select an installer or updater as the game. Before the first upstream startup, make separate backups of any existing Documents/hard_corps_uprising profile and portable user_data/ profile; a successful upstream migration removes the legacy folder.

steps.title: Install this title and any separately owned DLC
steps.instruction: Deliberately finish upstream setup outside Portcove using your own Hard Corps: Uprising XBLA LIVE package, title 58410A18 and content type 000D0000. Its extracted default.xex must be 12,955,648 bytes with SHA-256 530EDE8ED5271051A2AB19C077A97FB167E4F30B094C292E8F59D37D0D2069DC. Package container hashes can vary. Optional character DLC requires separately owned Marketplace packages for this title, content type 00000002; it is not required for the base game.

steps.title: Add the prepared native player
steps.instruction: Select hard_corps_uprising.exe (on Linux, the HardCorpsUprisingRecompiled AppImage), its containing package folder as working folder, and no arguments for ordinary Play. The embedded launcher resumes the native game in-process. Complete installation, updates and settings that require Restart outside a tracked session: Restart explicitly starts a successor process and exits this one, and the separate updater is not a game entry. Saving launch details and Play are separate Portcove actions.

steps.title: Keep upstream ownership and all active data roots
steps.instruction: Upstream/player owns runtime replacement. Preserve game/, logs/, the executable TOML and the complete user_data/ tree: settings.toml, 58410A18 local scores, achievements, cache and 0000000000000000/58410A18 DLC. Before the first upstream startup, back up the legacy Documents/hard_corps_uprising profile and any portable user_data/ profile separately. When upstream migrates legacy data, it moves the legacy folder by rename, or uses a staged verified copy and then removes the legacy folder after activation; successful migration does not leave the old profile in place. A failed migration falls back to the legacy root for that run and retries on the next startup. If only legacy cleanup fails after activation, portable user_data/ stays active and the legacy folder may remain. An unwritable portable root can also fall back to the system root. --user_data_root=<folder> selects that root without migration; --cache_root can select a separate cache. Preserve every active root and the separate backups. Portcove does not manage their backup, rollback, compatibility or deletion.

warnings: This guidance follows upstream release descriptions and source. Portcove has not inspected the archive or tested gameplay, saving or updates. Upstream calls its native Linux AppImage experimental.
The package includes an unlicensed TRG launcher that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
